contest.measure_text: City of Paramount Public Safety, Environment, Streets and Business Improvement Measure Without taxing residential property owners or renters, shall the ordinance to fund services for Paramount 911 response/public safety; reducing crime; responding to business burglaries; addressing street racing; monitoring/improving water/air quality; repairing streets/potholes; supporting businesses by annually levying between 8¢ and 13¢ per square foot on industrial/commercial properties only, with annual adjustments up to 3%, raising approximately $4,000,000 annually until ended by voters, requiring audits, spending disclosure, local control, be adopted? Supporters: Brenda Olmos, Mayor; Robert Luna, Sheriff; Coalition for Clean Air; J. Perez, Business Owner; MUSA nonprofit Opponents: None submitted.
contest.office: CITY OF PARAMOUNT SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION - MEASURE P
